podcast.body: Released in the summer of 1993, this debut record was a surprise for its accomplished, tight, and cohesive sound, coming from a band that seemingly emerged "out of nowhere." It was recorded in Los Angeles and produced by Mike Clink, known for his work on Guns N' Roses' *Appetite for Destruction*. The album achieved platinum status in Canada. "That debut record went platinum in Canada."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
